title: Slushie Bar Salts Raspberry Blueberry lemon 10ml E-Liquid
description: Raspberry Blueberry Lemon from Slushie Bar Salts is a vibrant and refreshing e-liquid that combines the rich flavours of Raspberries and Blueberries with a zesty Lemon twist. This Nic Salt blend is a perfect symphony of berry and citrus, offering a delightful taste experience with every puff. The e-liquid begins with the deep, sweet flavour of Raspberries, providing a robust and fruity base. This is beautifully complemented by the subtle, natural sweetness of Blueberries, adding complexity and depth. The Lemon comes through on the exhale, cutting through the berry sweetness with its bright and tangy notes, leaving a zesty and refreshing aftertaste. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
